candidates: When writing functions that sanitize or generate JavaScript identifier names by stripping invalid characters (e.g., `sanitizeIdentifier` in `csf-tools/vitest-plugin/component-transformer.ts` or similar AST-generation utilities), also verify that the resulting string does not start with a digit—JS identifiers cannot begin with `[0-9]`. If the sanitized value starts with a digit, prefix it with `_` (or another safe character) before returning it, in addition to any existing empty-string fallback.
